work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CXXVIII (address LF28574–28576 to Bishop Giuseppe Angelo Fazio of Tipasa) appoints him visitor and administrator of the new vicariate to be formed from Egypt and Arabia; LF28606 → LF28612 across page number 193 LF28609; complete 21 February 1837 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF28579–28579; the source closing at LF28656–28659 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulg piscatoris, die vigesima prima februarii mille- simo octingentesimo trigesimo septimo, pontifi- ficatus Nostri anno septimo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
